series: Why we stop doing things we know are good for us, Reason #26 (the good day)
hook: A great day is the easiest excuse to skip the next one.

gate.goal_link: any goal worked on in sessions (learning to code): one big day licenses a week off
gate.mechanism: licensing: progress toward a goal feels like permission to relax it (Fishbach & Dhar, goals as excuses; named as 'licensing', no numbers cited)
gate.universal: all in on Monday, gone by Wednesday

frame.obstacle: Monday's 3 hours becomes the reason to skip Tue-Thu

frame.fix: end every good day by booking the next: write tomorrow's step (fix one bug, 10 min) before closing the laptop
